subject: Request: band exception + sign-on for Lead MLOps candidate
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: New candidate — request for band exception + sign-on (Lead MLOps)

Hi team,

We have an offer window on a strong Lead MLOps candidate (Arjun Menon). Resume attached via the ATS, but highlights below:

- 8+ years infra/ML infra experience (last two years building infra for LLM training pipelines)
- Current comp: $220k base + 0.25% equity at private startup
- Counteroffer timeline: 72 hours; candidate prefers a firm offer by Tue COB

Hiring manager (Dylan) is asking to extend an out-of-band base + one-time sign-on to land this hire. Requested package:
- Base: $275,000
- One-time sign-on: $45,000 (split over first two pay cycles)
- Equity: 0.5% refresh (4y vest, standard cliff)

Reasoning provided: immediate runway risk for infra roadmap (LLM deployments) and inability to backfill a cancelled SDE req quickly. Manager requests headcount reallocation rather than new headcount.

Attachments: LeadMLOps-offer-draft-AR-20270625.pdf, comp-bands-2027-Q2.xlsx

Can you advise next steps for approval routing and whether we can approve the sign-on + equity refresh out-of-band?

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Senior Technical Recruiter
Redwood Inference

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 26 Jun 2027 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: New candidate — request for band exception + sign-on (Lead MLOps)

Laura / Monica — quick context from my side.

Short version: this hire is blocking two deliverables for Q3 (LLM inference rollout and customer reliability work). We lost the SDE req (REQ-2027-118) to headcount freeze uncertainty but the engineering roadmap still needs this skillset now. I propose reallocating that headcount to this role; candidate is already deep in our stack and can start within 3 weeks.

Benchmarks I used:
- Peer hires for Lead MLOps in comparable scale startups: total cash range $260k–$300k.
- Equity ask from candidate aligns with market for cross-functional infra leads.

Manager ask (confirmed):
- Approve base $275k (this is an L5/L6 blend; he's L6 on experience but current comp sits between our band boundaries)
- Approve $45k one-time sign-on to offset startup equity risk
- Approve 0.5% equity refresh — market competitive and retention-focused

If the committee prefers, we can split the sign-on into equity + cash mix, but candidate prefers cash given current liquidity needs.

Please see the draft offer attached. I'll hold a 48-hour soft hold on candidate acceptance window once we have consensus.

Thanks,
Dylan Brooks
Engineering Manager, Model Ops
Redwood Inference

Thanks for the context, Dylan. A few clarifying items before I can route for formal approval:

1) Headcount: confirm source. Is this a reallocation from an existing, already-open req (REQ-2027-118) or are we creating an exception to add headcount? We prefer reallocation where possible.
2) Comps: provide peer comp examples (names redacted) and note whether the candidate has competing offers with similar cash components.
3) Equity: our preference is to keep refreshes linked to tenure and performance milestones. 0.5% is on the high side for a non-executive IC; need VP sign-off.
4) Sign-on: We can approve a one-time cash sign-on up to $25k at People Ops level if headcount and budget are standard. Anything above requires VP + Finance sign-off.

Proposed interim solution: approve a $25k cash sign-on and agree to escalate equity and additional cash to VP People (Tessa) for discretionary approval. If you can confirm the headcount reallocation (point 1) I’ll start the approval flow and pre-fill the Offer Approval Form.

Laura Bennett
Senior Manager, People Operations
Redwood Inference

Team — after reviewing the notes and speaking separately with Dylan, I approve a one-time discretionary exception with the following conditions: 

- Headcount: Reallocation approved from cancelled SDE req REQ-2027-118; recruiting to close the loop in Workday and Jira.
- Cash: one-time sign-on of $45,000 approved (paid over first two pay cycles). This is considered a retention incentive tied to start date within 30 days.
- Base: base at $275,000 approved as an out-of-band comp for this critical hire.
- Equity: approve a 0.5% one-time refresh contingent on 12-month retention milestone (50% of refresh vests after 12 months, remainder on normal 4y schedule). VP approves because of market urgency.
- Deadline: Candidate must accept offer by 2027-06-30 23:59 PT or approvals will be rescinded.

I’m copying Finance to confirm budget transfer details and Compensation to record this as a band exception for Q2 reporting. Marcus — please confirm you can route the funds from engineering underspend. Monica — please get the candidate to sign via DocuSign (link below) and ensure the Offer Approval Form is completed with the above conditions.

DocuSign offer link: https://app.docusign.com/Envelope/ABC123-Offer-AR

Thanks,
